info.title: World Gaming Connect public API

contact.name: WGC Live support — the Support button in the backoffice

info.description:
This document is the contract. Client code MUST branch only on `error.code`, never on `error.message`. `message` is for a human reading a log.

`/v1` does not break without notice. New fields may appear at any time — ignore a field you do not know. A field is removed or changes meaning only after it is marked **deprecated** in this document and kept for at least **90 days**; an incompatible change of the whole API is `/v2`, and `/v1` keeps running beside it. Before the first live integration two changes were made without that notice: 1.1.0 removed `supplier` and `label` from `Game`, 1.7.0 replaced `betType` and `bonusTriggered` with `actions`. The same holds for the wallet requests WGC sends to your Callback URL: ignore a field you do not know, never reject the request for it.

**Signature sample** — to check your own code. Secret `test-secret`, body (these bytes exactly as written, no spaces and no line break, one line) `{"command":"getBalance","playerId":"p1","currency":"USD"}` → `X-WGC-Signature: 85ea22c889c04ff1b623b7b6c300e47f506dd310acfbb655cbe39e71456e46d3` (hex of HMAC-SHA256 over the raw body bytes).

Support: write to Live support («Поддержка») — the button in the side menu of the backoffice.

Error codes (stable forever): unauthorized, forbidden (the call came from an address outside the Account's list of addresses), not_found, invalid_request, currency_not_granted, balance_required, player_blocked, country_restricted, rate_limited, supplier_unavailable, supplier_rejected, try_later, busy, wrong_cell, server_error.

servers.description: Production API host. The backoffice host bo.worldgamingconnect.com answers 404 on /v1.

get.description:
Returns games granted to **this** Account, not the subtree. Page size is 200 and is not a query parameter — the client cannot ask for more.

`publicId` is the game number, `<name>-<n>` (`sweet-bonanza-1`): the game's clean name in lower case with hyphens and the next number for that name across all brands. It is issued once and **never changes** — not when the game is renamed, not when it moves to another brand, not when the game provider changes their own id. It does not encode the provider. The client may key their database on it. A game with no brand yet is not listed.

**Syncing with `updatedSince`.** First call without it — that is the full catalog. Save `syncedAt` from the response and send it back as `updatedSince` on the next call: you get back only what changed since then, plus any game that must be removed (`removed: true`). A change WGC makes to a game's name, brand or image counts the same as one from its provider. This does not cover games being granted to or revoked from this Account — that changes what you're allowed to see, not what changed about a game, and shows up as items entering or leaving the full list rather than as a delta event.

parameters.name: updatedSince
parameters.description: An ISO 8601 date-time with a zone (`2026-10-10T00:00:00Z`, `…+03:00`); anything else, a calendar date that does not exist included, is `invalid_request`. Send back the `syncedAt` from a previous response to get a delta instead of the full catalog. A removed game — gone from the game provider's feed or switched off at the game provider — is included in a delta (`removed: true`); a full list (no `updatedSince`) never includes one.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: When set, only your grants that cover this currency take part in building the list. A currency the Account does not sell is `currency_not_granted` (400), not an empty list. Omitted — all granted games; currency is checked at session open.

post.summary: Open a game for a player
post.description:
`playerId` is the casino's identifier. WGC does not create players; the balance lives at the casino.

Optional `Idempotency-Key` (≤128 printable ASCII, 24 hours): the same key and body returns the saved response without calling the game provider. The same key with a different body is `invalid_request`. A retry is answered from the saved response only while the game is still granted; a revoked game answers `not_found`. If a previous open with that key is still running, `try_later`. A key belongs to the session's latest open: an open of the same session with another key replaces it, and a retry with the older key opens the game again (same `sessionId` and link).

`url` is a WGC link (`https://play.worldgamingconnect.com/play/…`) that redirects the player's browser to the game. Open it in the player's browser as is (page or iframe); do not fetch it from your server — WGC records the device that opens it. It works for 30 minutes after it is issued and then while the player keeps playing; after that, or at once when the Account is blocked or deleted, it answers 410 and the game is opened again with a new `POST /v1/sessions`.

Opening the same game for the same player / currency / mode while a session is `open` returns that session's `sessionId` and the same link; the game behind it is opened at the game provider again.

`mode: real` needs money on the Account — balance plus credit limit above zero — or the answer is `balance_required`. `mode: demo` moves no money and is never refused for this: test your launch integration in demo.

A player WGC has blocked gets `player_blocked` (403) on every new open, a retry by `Idempotency-Key` included; a session that is already open keeps playing.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. Same key and same body within 24 hours returns the saved response. Different body → `invalid_request`. In-flight open → `try_later`. A failed open is not kept under the key: a repeat with the same key is a new attempt.

get.description:
One `writeBet` or `rollback` of this Account by the `transactionId` WGC sent to your Callback URL. `status` is `accepted`, `refused`, `failed` or `unknown`; an operation WGC has not settled yet is `unknown`. `rollback` is set when WGC asked your casino to reverse the operation.

Only **this** Account's own data is visible (not its branch). The numbers are the ones your casino saw: the `transactionId` and `roundId` WGC sent to your Callback URL and the `sessionId` of `POST /v1/sessions`. A number that is not this Account's and a number that does not exist are the same `not_found`. Amounts are strings with a point. Limits are those of `GET /v1/games` (120 a minute per key by default). The game provider, its label, its own numbers and raw bodies are never in an answer.

get.summary: A round and all its operations
get.description:
One round by the `roundId` WGC sent to your Callback URL, with every operation of it in the order they came. A round that was opened again (a later generation) is one answer under the same number. `bet`, `win` and `ggr` count the accepted `writeBet`s whose rollback your casino did not take. `roundDetails` is where a link to the picture of the round will be, when a game provider gives one; today it is always `null`.

Only **this** Account's own data is visible (not its branch). The numbers are the ones your casino saw: the `transactionId` and `roundId` WGC sent to your Callback URL and the `sessionId` of `POST /v1/sessions`. A number that is not this Account's and a number that does not exist are the same `not_found`. Amounts are strings with a point. Limits are those of `GET /v1/games` (120 a minute per key by default). The game provider, its label, its own numbers and raw bodies are never in an answer.

One session by the `sessionId` of `POST /v1/sessions`: the player, the game, the state and the totals of its accepted bets (rounds are counted as in the Reports of the backoffice: one round is one round of the game, a free round counts as a round but not as a round with a bet). The link of the session, the device and the country of the player's browser are not returned.

Only **this** Account's own data is visible (not its branch). The numbers are the ones your casino saw: the `transactionId` and `roundId` WGC sent to your Callback URL and the `sessionId` of `POST /v1/sessions`. A number that is not this Account's and a number that does not exist are the same `not_found`. Amounts are strings with a point. Limits are those of `GET /v1/games` (120 a minute per key by default). The game provider, its label, its own numbers and raw bodies are never in an answer.

post.summary: WGC asks the casino for a player balance
post.description:
Direction: game provider → WGC → casino Callback URL.

WGC POSTs to the Account Callback URL. The casino MUST verify `X-WGC-Signature` against the **raw body bytes** before parsing JSON — verifying after parse is meaningless.

Timeout T3: the casino MUST answer faster than T3 (currently 3 seconds; game provider T2 is 5 s, so 2 s stay in reserve). Slower than T3 → the bet is refused. WGC does not take credit risk for a slow casino.

parameters.name: X-WGC-Signature
parameters.description: HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body with the Callback Secret, hex digest.

post.summary: WGC posts a bet and a win in one call
post.description:
Same Callback URL as getBalance. `writeBet` carries **bet and win in one call** (this is what M8 symmetric commission sits on).

`transactionId` is a WGC number (UUID), one per money operation: a repeat of the same operation arrives with the same number, a rollback with the number of the bet it cancels.

**Integration condition:** handling `writeBet` MUST be idempotent on `transactionId`. A repeat with the same `transactionId` MUST NOT debit twice and MUST return the same balance. WGC may crash after answering the game provider or before; the game provider will retry. Without casino-side idempotency the player pays twice.

Who repeats: the **game provider** repeats a `writeBet`, WGC does not. A repeat of an operation WGC already settled is answered from what WGC stored, without calling you again; only when the earlier attempt never reached you (a `failed` row) does the call go out again, with the same `transactionId` — answer it exactly as you would the first one. A call you did not answer within T3 (3 seconds) is refused to the game provider and WGC then asks you to reverse it with `rollback` (`reason: unknown_outcome`).

parameters.name: X-WGC-Signature
parameters.description: HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body with the Callback Secret, hex digest.

win.summary: The result of that round: no stake, a win of 2.50

200.description: Updated balance, or a refused debit.

refused.summary: Refused: the player cannot cover the bet

post.summary: WGC asks the casino to reverse a transaction entirely
post.description:
Optional command on the same Callback URL, same HMAC of the raw body. Reverse the writeBet named by `transactionId` entirely: return its `bet` to the player and take back its `win`. Sent when your answer to that writeBet never reached us (`reason: unknown_outcome`), or when the game provider cancelled a transaction that was settled (`reason: supplier_cancel`).

A transaction you never booked: change nothing. In every case answer with HTTP 2xx (200 is the usual; 201 and 202 are read too; a 204 has no body, so no balance, and is unreadable) and `{"balance": <number>}`. A repeat with the same `transactionId` MUST NOT reverse twice.

The command is optional. 404, 405, or `{"error":"unknown_command"}` means the casino does not implement rollback; WGC stops retrying after two such answers.

Schedule: WGC repeats the `rollback` until you take it (HTTP 200 with a balance). The first attempt comes about a minute after the missing answer (at once for a cancellation by the game provider, within the minute the worker runs), then after 5, 15, 60, 360 and 1440 minutes, and then once a day until 30 days have passed since the bet it reverses; after that the retries stop (`rollback.state` `expired`) and WGC staff settle the case with you — keep your own record of every transaction (by `transactionId`) for at least 30 days. While a request is in flight WGC does not send another for the same transaction. After two "not supported" answers the retries stop and WGC staff settle the case with you.

parameters.name: X-WGC-Signature
parameters.description: HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body with the Callback Secret, hex digest.

200.description: Current balance after the undo (or unchanged if there was nothing to undo).

taken.summary: Taken: the bet is back, the win is taken back

unsupported.summary: Not implemented (HTTP 200 form; 404 or 405 mean the same)

apiKey.name: X-API-Key
apiKey.description: Key issued in the backoffice (`wgc_live_…`). Stored as HMAC. Check: the key exists, it is not revoked, the Account is not blocked. Any failure is `unauthorized` with no extra detail — do not tell the caller whether the key is missing or revoked. Requests are not signed; TLS carries the key. WGC signs the other direction (callbacks to the casino).

X-Request-Id.description: Same value as `requestId` in the body. Quote this in support.

Retry-After.description: How many seconds to wait before the next call.

ErrorCode.description: Stable machine code. Rename is forbidden; add a new code, or change API version to delete one. `forbidden`: this Account allows `/v1` calls only from the addresses of its list, and the call came from another.

message.description: For a human log. Client code must ignore this and branch on `code`.

cell.description: Added in 1.18.0. Only with `wrong_cell`: the code of the cell that serves this Account (or the session or round of the number).

endpoint.description: Added in 1.18.0. Only with `wrong_cell`: the address of the API of that cell — repeat the same request there; `null` when WGC has not set it.

publicId.description: The game number: the clean name in lower case with hyphens plus a number (never an underscore). Issued once, never rewritten.

universalId.description: Added in 1.13.0. The number of the GAME, the same for every source (copy) behind it: the clean name in lower case with hyphens, and `.2`, `.3` when another brand has a game of the same text. It contains a dot only in that case, and a `publicId` never does. Issued once, never rewritten, whatever source your catalog shows for the game now. Key your own database on it: `publicId` is the number of ONE source and changes when the source behind the game changes (a `removed: true` row and a new row in the delta). Open a game by it with `POST /v1/sessions` (`universalId` instead of `publicId`). `null` only for a game whose number is not issued yet.

version.description: Added in 1.19.0. The number of this copy among the copies of the game your Account sees (1, 2, …), by the number in `publicId`, never by price. Present only when your Account is switched to the mode «all copies» and only for a game with two copies or more; otherwise absent. Several copies of one game have the same `universalId`, `name` and `brand`: `version` tells them apart. Open a game by `publicId` — a `universalId` that names several copies answers `invalid_request`.

demoSupported.description: `capabilities.demo === true`. `false` includes "not known", same as capabilities. A demo session (test key) opens only when this is `true` — otherwise `invalid_request` with the message "Demo mode is not available for this game.".

capabilities.description: What the game itself can do. Each of the four values is `true` or `false` and never `null` (1.21.0): `true` — confirmed; `false` — no, or not confirmed. Before 1.21.0 a flag nobody had checked came as `null`.

rtpSettable.description: Added in 1.16.0. `true` — an `rtp` sent in `POST /v1/sessions` for this game reaches the game provider; `false` — it is not passed on (and the call is not refused). Always present; `false` for the game of a test key.

betLimitsSettable.description: Added in 1.16.0. `true` — `betMin` and `betMax` sent in `POST /v1/sessions` for this game reach the game provider; `false` — they are not passed on (and the call is not refused). Always present; `false` for the game of a test key.

image.description: Ready-to-use URL. The client may substitute another size in the path. Allowed sizes: multiples of 50, each side from 32 to 1200 inclusive, aspect ratio at most 4:1. Aspects: square, portrait, landscape. Example: https://img.worldgamingconnect.com/pragmatic/sweetbonanza/square/300x300.webp

restrictedCountries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, upper case: where the game provider forbids the game. `[]` means no restriction is known. WGC refuses a launch when it knows the player is there (`playerCountry` of the open, or the country of the browser that opens the link); keep your own geo checks too.

removed.description: Always present. `true` means this game must be removed from the client's own catalog. Only appears as `true` in a response to a request that carried `updatedSince` — a full list (no `updatedSince`) never includes a removed game at all, so `removed` is `false` on every row there. A game switched off at the game provider, or one WGC does not sell yet, is `removed: true` in a delta.

syncedAt.description: When the server started processing this request — not when it finished. Save this and send it back as `updatedSince` on the next call, so nothing that changed while this response was in flight falls between two syncs.

OpenSessionRequest.description: Send exactly one of `publicId` (a source, as before) and `universalId` (the game; added in 1.13.0). Both, or neither, is `invalid_request` ("Send publicId or universalId, not both." / "publicId or universalId is required.").

universalId.description: Added in 1.13.0. The `universalId` of a game of `GET /v1/games`. WGC opens the source (`publicId`) that `GET /v1/games` gives your Account for that game now; the answer says which one. A game that is not in your catalog is `not_found`, like an unknown `publicId`. A repeat by `Idempotency-Key` with the same body gives the same answer.

playerId.description: Casino-side player id: 1 to 64 printable ASCII characters. WGC does not parse it.

mode.description: `real` — play on money, opens with a live key (`wgc_live_…`). `demo` — opens with a TEST key (`wgc_test_…`) for any game of your catalog (grants, label, blocks and `demoSupported` apply as for a live key); a test key never opens a game of the catalog on money: `real` with it is `not_found` (the test game opens in either mode). Until 2026-11-18 a demo with a live key still opens and the answer carries `notice`; from 2026-11-18 it is `400 invalid_request`: "Demo opens with a test key (wgc_test_…); a live key opens real-money play only." The catalog for choosing a game is read with the live key (`GET /v1/games` of a test key shows only the test game).

language.description: Optional. A language code: two letters (ISO 639-1, `en`), or with a region after `-` or `_` (`pt-BR`, `zh_CN`), any case. WGC brings it to one two-letter code: the region is cut, the case lowered, a code casinos write by the country is replaced by the language (`ua` → `uk`, `kz` → `kk`, `cz` → `cs`, `gr` → `el`, `jp` → `ja`, `kr` → `ko`, `cn` → `zh`, `dk` → `da`, `se` → `sv`, `ee` → `et`, `si` → `sl`, `br` → `pt`, `ge` → `ka`, `by` → `be`, `rs` → `sr`, `vn` → `vi`, `ir` → `fa`, `il` and `iw` → `he`, `in` → `id`, `my` → `ms`), and a code that is not a language of ISO 639-1 is `en`. A game is never refused for a language it does not know. The same code goes to the game provider, to the page of the exit and back to you as `language` in the answer. Omitted — the game provider chooses. A value that is not a code (`english`, `eng`) is `invalid_request`.

playerCountry.description: Optional. The country you know for the player: two letters, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, any case (stored upper case). Used to cross-check the country of the browser that opens the game, and to refuse a game the game provider forbids there: a country in the game's `restrictedCountries` is `country_restricted` (403) and nothing is opened. A wrong format is `invalid_request`. Not part of the Idempotency-Key fingerprint.

platform.description: The player's device. Some games use it to open the mobile build; the rest ignore it.

casinoSessionId.description: Optional. Your own number of this session: 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters, no space at either end. WGC keeps it as sent and gives it back — as `casinoSessionId` in the answer of this method, in the lookups and the events of this session, and in the body of every call WGC makes to your Callback URL for it (`getBalance`, `writeBet`, `rollback`; it is inside the signed body). It is never sent to a game provider. Without it nothing changes: no field is added anywhere. Part of the Idempotency-Key fingerprint (the same key with another number is `invalid_request`). A later open of the same open session with the field replaces it.

rtp.description: Added in 1.16.0. Optional. The RTP you ask for this launch: a whole percent from 75 to 96. It replaces the RTP set for the brand and for your account in the backoffice. If the game does not take an RTP, nothing is passed to the game provider and the call is not refused; what was passed is in `applied`. `GET /v1/games` marks the games that take it: `capabilities.rtpSettable`.

betMin.description: Added in 1.16.0. Optional. The minimum bet for this launch, in the currency of the game: an amount above zero with at most 2 decimals, a string (`"0.20"`) or a number. Send it alone or with `betMax`. If either of the two is sent, the pair of the request replaces the pair set for the brand and for all brands as a whole: the edge you did not send is not taken from them. `betMin` above `betMax` is `invalid_request`. If the game does not take bet limits, nothing is passed to the game provider and the call is not refused; what was passed is in `applied`. `capabilities.betLimitsSettable` of `GET /v1/games` marks the games that take them.

betMax.description: Added in 1.16.0. Optional. The maximum bet for this launch, in the currency of the game. The same rules as `betMin`.

url.description: Launch link for the player's browser (`https://play.worldgamingconnect.com/play/…`). Redirects (302) to the game. Do not fetch it from your server.

notice.description: Added in 1.14.0. Only for a demo opened with a live key before 2026-11-18: "From 2026-11-18 a live key opens real-money play only; open demo with a test key (wgc_test_…)." Absent in every other answer.

sessionId.description: Opaque WGC session token. Not a sequential number and not the game provider session id.

casinoSessionId.description: Only if you sent `casinoSessionId` when you opened the session: your own number of it, as you sent it.

publicId.description: Added in 1.13.0. The source that was opened: the `publicId` you sent, or the one WGC chose for the `universalId` you sent.

universalId.description: Added in 1.13.0. The number of the game that was opened (the same for every source behind it); `null` only for a game whose number is not issued yet.

language.description: Added in 1.12.0. Only if you sent `language`: the language the game is opened with — your code after the rules of the request (region cut, case lowered, `ua` → `uk` and the like, a code that is not a language → `en`). Not sent — no field.

expiresAt.description: Until when the link opens the game even if the player does not play: the latest POST /v1/sessions for this session + 30 minutes. After it the link works only while the player keeps playing.

applied.description: Added in 1.16.0. What WENT to the game provider at this launch. `null` means nothing went: you did not ask for it and none is set for the brand and for your account, or the game does not take it (see `capabilities` of `GET /v1/games`). It is the value the provider received, which can differ from the asked one: a game takes the nearest value it has. A retry with the same `Idempotency-Key` returns the same `applied`. Present in every answer of this method, except if WGC could not read the saved values at that moment (the game is open all the same).

Actions.description: What happened, in the words of our dictionary (v1), in this order: `bet` — a stake; `ante_bet` — a raised stake; `bonus_buy` — a bonus was bought (`bonus_triggered` is never set together with it); `bonus_triggered` — a bonus fell on its own; `free_spins` — free spins of a game (awarded, or played in the series that a bonus started); `respin` — a respin; `promo_freespin` — a promotional free spin; `win` — a win; `no_win` — a call with no stake and no win; `jackpot` — a jackpot payout; `tournament_prize` — a tournament prize; `refund` — a refund; `rollback` — a rollback; `other` — a signal our dictionary does not know yet. Open list: new codes are added and documented; an unknown code is informational, never an error.

transactionId.description: The `transactionId` of the Callback (a WGC number, opaque).

command.description: A bet and its win. A balance request has no `transactionId`; a rollback is not a line of its own, it is the `rollback` field of the bet it reverses.

errorCode.description: The refusal word (yours, when your casino refused; otherwise ours). Values: see the errorCode table in the documentation.

state.description: `pending` — the rollback will be sent; `sent` — sent, your answer recorded; `unsupported` — your endpoint does not support rollback, WGC staff settle it; `resolved` — closed; `expired` (1.12.0) — 30 days passed since the bet and WGC stopped repeating the rollback: the dispute is open and WGC staff settle it with you.

casinoSessionId.description: Only if you sent `casinoSessionId` when you opened the session: your own number of it, as you sent it.
Only if you sent `casinoSessionId` when you opened the session: your own number of it, as you sent it.

multiplier.description: The multiplier as the game provider says it; `null` where it says nothing.

roundDetails.description: Reserved for a link to the picture of the round. Always `null` today.

casinoSessionId.description: Only if you sent `casinoSessionId` when you opened the session: your own number of it, as you sent it.

universalId.description: Added in 1.13.0. The number of the game of this session, the same for every source behind it; `null` only for a game whose number is not issued yet.

firstOpenedAt.description: When the player's browser first opened the link.

lastSeenAt.description: The time of the latest accepted wallet call of the session; before the first call — when the session was opened.

expiresAt.description: Until when the link opens the game without play; `null` unless the session is `open`.

applied.description: Added in 1.17.0. What WENT to the game provider at the launch of this session — the same as `applied` in the answer of `POST /v1/sessions`: `null` means nothing went (you did not ask for it and none was set, or the game does not take it). A session of a test key: all three `null`. A session opened before 1.16.0: all three `null`.

test.description: Present only on requests sent by the backoffice integration tester. Answer as usual.

casinoSessionId.description: Only if you sent `casinoSessionId` when you opened the session: your own number of it, as you sent it. It is inside the signed body.

roundId.description: WGC round number (UUID); all writeBet calls of one game round carry one roundId.

transactionId.description: WGC number of this money operation (UUID).

kind.description: What the money is for. Sent today: `play` (an ordinary spin) and `refund` (a stake returned inside the same round). `jackpot`, `tournament` and `bonus` are reserved. Refuse a value you do not recognise; do not guess.

roundFinished.description: The provider closed the round. Absent — treat the round as still open.

freespinId.description: The money is an ordinary win — credit it once per `transactionId`. Absent on every other call; never `null`. A win of a bonus WGC cannot tie to a bonus arrives without it.

test.description: Present only on requests sent by the backoffice integration tester; bet and win are then always 0. Answer as usual.

casinoSessionId.description: Only if you sent `casinoSessionId` when you opened the session: your own number of it, as you sent it. It is inside the signed body.

error.description: Closed list: `insufficient_funds` (the player cannot cover the bet), `player_blocked` (the player may not play), `limit_exceeded` (a limit on your side). Any other word is still a refusal; WGC keeps it in the journal as your own word.

balance.description: Optional: the player's balance at the moment of refusal.

transactionId.description: The writeBet to reverse, as you received it.

bet.description: That writeBet's bet — return it to the player.

win.description: That writeBet's win — take it back from the player.

reason.description: `unknown_outcome`: your answer to that writeBet never reached us. `supplier_cancel`: the game provider cancelled a transaction that was settled.

casinoSessionId.description: Only if you sent `casinoSessionId` when you opened the session of that bet: your own number of it, as you sent it. It is inside the signed body.

Timeouts.description: T1 casino waits for our /v1: 15s. T2 the game provider waits for our callback: their side. T3 we wait for the casino: currently 3s (game provider T2 is 5 s, 2 s in reserve). T4 we wait for the game provider on session open: 10s. Casino MUST answer before T3 or the stake is refused.

delta.summary: Delta (updatedSince = the syncedAt you saved): a changed game and a game to remove

round.summary: A closed round with one operation

ErrLookupNotFound.description: No such number for this Account (a number that is another Account's reads the same).

error.message: No such transaction for this Account.

ErrWrongCell.description: The Account of the key, or the session or round of the number, is served at another address (a cell of WGC). Repeat the same request at `error.endpoint`; `error.cell` is the code of that cell.

error.message: This Account is served at another address: repeat the request at error.endpoint.

ErrUnauthorized.description: Missing, unknown, revoked, or blocked key. Same code for all of these.

ErrForbidden.description: The key is valid, but this Account allows `/v1` calls only from the addresses of its list and this call came from another address (your WGC manager keeps the list). Not returned by `GET /v1/health`.

error.message: Address not allowed for this account

ErrSession403.description: player_blocked: WGC blocked this player of your casino (new opens only; an open session keeps playing); or country_restricted: the game provider forbids the game in the `playerCountry` you sent; or forbidden: this Account allows `/v1` calls only from the addresses of its list and this call came from another address.

error.message: This game is not available in the player's country.
Address not allowed for this account

ErrNotFound.description: Game missing or not granted to this Account.

error.message: Currency is not granted to this Account.

ErrBalanceRequired.description: balance_required: a real session needs money on the Account (balance plus credit limit above zero). Demo is not refused for this.

error.message: A real session needs money on the Account. Top up, or open the game in demo with a test key (wgc_test_…).

ErrRateLimited.description: Too many requests. Wait `Retry-After` seconds. Limits per key per minute, by default: `POST /v1/sessions` 600; `GET /v1/games` and the lookups by number (`/v1/transactions/{id}`, `/v1/rounds/{id}`, `/v1/sessions/{id}`) 120. A test key has its own limits of the test mode. Your WGC manager can raise the limits for your Account. More than 100 requests a second from one address to `/v1` (a burst of up to 200) are refused with `429 rate_limited` before the count per key.

ErrSupplierUnavailable.description: Game provider did not answer in T4.

ErrBusy.description: WGC is under heavy load and opens no new sessions for a moment (`busy`). Sessions that are already open keep playing: their bets and wins are not refused. Retry after the seconds of `Retry-After`.

error.message: WGC is under heavy load. Retry in a few seconds.

ErrSupplierRejected.description: Game provider refused to open the game.

ErrSession409.description: Game provider refused to open the game, or a previous open with this Idempotency-Key is still running.

error.message: Previous open is still in progress. Retry in a second.
